class.name: JarTorusSdf
class.brief_description: A signed distance field (SDF) torus primitive.
class.description: Represents a torus (ring) as a signed distance field, lying in the XZ plane around the Y axis. Defined by a center, a major radius (distance from the center to the middle of the tube) and a minor radius (the tube thickness). Combine with [JarTransformSdf] to orient it differently.

members.member: The origin point of the torus in 3D space.
Distance from the center to the middle of the tube (the ring radius).
Radius of the tube itself (the ring thickness).
